column1: # Labels and tooltips of this mod's settings and key bind (ModHelper.GetLocalized). Format: key

column2: Closes container and machine windows at once (documents and everything else Esc can close too, if turned on in the mod settings). Locked windows stay open.
Close the windows of containers and machines, except locked ones (click the lock left of a window's close button to lock it). Set the key in Options > Key Binds (default: Backspace).
Also close papers opened from Document items (newspaper, notes, guides, business cards…).
Close everything else Esc can close
Also close everything else Esc can close: calendar, tablet, phone, scanners, End the Day, Wild's Network, and other mods' windows that close on Esc (not the pause menu or Options).

Show the lock left of the close button of container and machine windows. When off, the locks are hidden and every window counts as unlocked: Esc, the close-all key and the 25-window limit close them as usual. The windows you locked are remembered and are locked again when you turn this back on.
